1) Composition according to Claim 1 wherein the compound of formula I is 5-(7- methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzoxepin-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic __and is clearly identified as a different structural entity__ and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof. (Currently amended)

3) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1 or 2, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action, __wherein the active ingredients are not derived from an indole structure__. (Currently amended)

4) Composition according to one or more of the Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of __from 0.00001 to 10 per cent by weight, further specifying the active ingredient is unique to this composition__. (Currently amended)

6) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient __one or more agents that do not include an indole-based structure__ in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight. (Currently amended)

7) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __not creating any additional risk of using indole derivatives__. (Currently amended)

8) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the prophylaxis and/or treatment of skin diseases which __are not solely reliant on indole derivatives__ and have an inflammatory and/or immunoallergic component. (Currently amended)

9) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development __that does not include any composition derived from indole structures__. (Currently amended)

10) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair __without relying on indole derivatives as active components__. (Currently amended)

11) Use of active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 as skin lightening and/or skin whitening active agent __distinct from the indole derivatives described in the cited prior art__. (Currently amended)

12) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 or 2 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening __with an emphasis on alternatives to indole-based compounds__. (Currently amended)

13) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin, __not limited to indole derivatives for efficacy__. (Currently amended)

14) Use the active ingredient of Claim 1 or 2 for the prophylaxis against time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, in particular for prophylaxis against dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, __that does not rely on indole derivatives, and/or for the reduction or prevention of the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin__. (Currently amended)
